description: Each row represents a liability, either accounts payable or accrued liabilities. It records the name of the liability. It links to the disclosure that contains details about these financial obligations.
Each row details an accounts payable entry, noting the name of the party owed money. It links to the disclosure table using its ID, allowing related disclosures to be found.

Each row represents an accrued liability, which is a debt that has been incurred but not yet paid. It records the name of the liability. It links to the disclosure table, providing details on each liability's description.

Each row records the accumulated other comprehensive income or loss (a financial figure). It includes a name for the item. This table links to disclosures, providing details of what is included in the figure.

Each row represents an address, either physical or virtual. It records the postal address and a unique identifier for any linked virtual address. It links to other addresses for relationships like "index to" or "related to".
Each row represents an allowance for credit losses, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the allowance. It links to the related financial disclosure.
Each row lists securities excluded from the earnings per share calculation. It records the name of the security. It links to the disclosure document that contains this information.
Each row represents an asset, identified by its unique ID. It records the asset's name. This table links to the financial statement elements to show where assets are reported.
Each row records an impairment charge for an asset, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the impairment. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these charges.

Each row discloses an asset retirement obligation (a financial liability for the decommissioning of an asset). It records whether a name is provided. It links to the broader disclosure record that contains it.
Each row represents an autonomous agent (a self-operating entity). It records the unique identifier for each agent. There are no links or references to other tables.
Each row represents a security that is available for sale. It records the name of the security. It links to disclosures, providing details on each security's availability.

Each row records a cost related to business acquisitions, integrations, restructuring, or other activities. It includes the name of the cost. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these costs.
Each row contains preliminary information about a business acquisition. It records the name of the business involved. It links to disclosures that provide more details.
Each row discloses information about a business combination (a merger or acquisition). It records the name of the combination. It links to the broader disclosure record that contains more details.
Each row represents a capital unit, identified by a unique ID. It contains the name of the unit. It links to financial disclosures, allowing details of each unit's financial information to be found.
Each row represents a cash and cash equivalent account, identified by an ID. It records the name of the account. It links to the financial disclosure it belongs to.
Each row discloses the company's cash and cash equivalents, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the asset. This table links to broader disclosure information.
Each row represents a cash equivalent or short-term investment. It records the name of the asset. It links to the disclosure that contains this information, providing context for its reporting.
Each row records a change in an accounting estimate, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the estimate changed. It links to related disclosures for more details.
Each row records a change in the fair value of plan assets. It includes an identifier and the name of the asset. It links to disclosures, providing context for financial statements.

Each row represents a commitment, contingency, or guarantee. It records the name of the item. It links to the disclosure that contains it, providing context about financial obligations and potential liabilities.

Each row represents a line item in the comprehensive income section of financial statements. It records the name of the income or expense. It links to the broader category of financial statement elements.
Each row represents a comprehensive income or loss item. It records the name of the item. It links to the disclosure that contains it, providing context for financial statements.

Each row represents a contract, identifying its parties and management. It records the effective date, expiration date, and title of the contract. It links to the corporation that manages it, showing which contracts are handled by each company.
Each row represents a party involved in a contract. It records the unique identifier for a contract party, linking to a person's ID. This table tracks who is part of various contracts.
Each row records a stock conversion, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the conversion. It links to related disclosures for more details.

Each row represents a corporation, recording its ID, legal name, domicile country, ticker symbol, and classification. It links to the country where the corporation is domiciled and connects to tables for contracts managed by the corporation and financial reports provided by it.
Each row represents an investment valued using the cost method. It records the name of the investment. It links to financial disclosures, allowing details about these investments to be found.
Each row records details of a retirement plan's costs, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the cost. It links to disclosures, providing context for financial information.

Each row represents a country, identified by its ID. It contains the country's name and numeric code. It is linked to other tables that record where corporations are domiciled, people were born, and addresses are located.
Each row represents a currency and includes its numeric code, name, and the number of minor units (like cents in dollars). It links to where amounts are recorded in this currency.
Each row represents a debt identified by a unique ID. It contains the name of the debtor. It links to financial disclosures, allowing details of specific debts to be found.
Each row records a debt conversion, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the conversion. It links to related disclosures for more details.
Each row represents a deferred tax asset or liability. It records the name of the item. It links to the disclosure that provides more details about these financial items.

Each row records the amount of a defined benefit plan recognized in other comprehensive income or loss. It includes an identifier and the name of the item. It links to the broader disclosure record, providing context for financial statements.
Each row represents a financial derivative, identified by its unique ID. It records the derivative's name. It links to related disclosures, allowing details about the derivative to be found.

Each row is a disclosure record that describes financial metrics and their context. It includes details like the metric year, start date, document type, end date, and value. This table links to elements of financial reports, providing detailed information about various financial aspects such as liabilities, assets, income, and more.

Each row records a distribution to an owner, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the owner receiving the distribution. It links to the financial statement element that tracks these distributions.
Each row records a restriction on paying dividends. It includes the name of the restriction. It links to disclosures, providing more details about each restriction.
Each row represents a payable dividend, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the dividend. It links to the disclosure record that contains more details about the dividend.
Each row reconciles the effective income tax rate used in financial statements. It records a name for the reconciliation. It links to disclosures that provide more details.

Each row represents an element of a financial statement (like assets, liabilities, or revenues). It records details such as the metric year, start and end dates, document type, unit, and computed status. It links to other tables like assets, expenses, and revenues, allowing detailed financial analysis.

Each row represents an element of a financial report, identified by its ID. It records which financial reports the element belongs to. It connects to disclosures and elements of financial statements, linking these together in the document structure.
Each row is an email address, identified by a unique ID. It indicates whether the address has a value. It links to other virtual addresses for cross-referencing.

Each row represents a location for an entity, identified by its unique ID. It records the name of the location. It links to disclosure information, allowing details about financial statements related to that location.
Each row represents an equity item, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the equity. It links to the financial statement element it belongs to.
Each row represents an investment accounted for using the equity method. It records the name of the investee company. It links to disclosures providing more details about these investments.
Each row records an error correction or prior period adjustment. It includes a unique identifier and the name of the adjustment. It links to disclosures, providing details on financial corrections.
Each row represents an expense with a unique identifier and the name of the expense. It links to the financial statement elements, showing where these expenses are recorded.
Each row records the extinguishment of a debt, identified by an ID. It includes the name associated with the debt. It links to disclosures that provide more details.
Each row represents an extraordinary item (an unusual financial event). It records whether the item has a name. It links to the disclosure that contains more details about the item.
Each row represents a financial instrument (like a bond or stock). It notes whether the instrument can be transferred. No other tables link to it.

Each row represents a financial instrument subject to mandatory redemption, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the instrument. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these instruments.
Each row represents a financial market, identified by an ID and its name. It links to the securities traded on that market, showing which markets trade specific securities.
Each row represents a financial metric (a measure of financial performance). It records the metric's name. It links to disclosures, providing details about each metric.

Each row represents a financial report, identified by a unique ID. It records who provided the report and its unique identifier. It links to the corporation that provided it and to the elements within the report.
Each row represents a financial service account, identified by an ID. It records who owns and manages the account, along with its start date and account number. It links to the owner of the account.

Each row records the allowance for credit losses on a financing receivable. It includes an identifier and the name of the allowance. It links to disclosures, providing context about financial statements.
Each row is a credit quality indicator for a financing receivable. It records the name of the indicator. It links to disclosures, providing details on the financial health of receivables.
Each row represents a financing receivable (money owed for a financial transaction). It records the receivable's name. It links to disclosures, providing context about financial statements.
Each row represents a past-due financing receivable, identified by a unique ID. It records whether the receivable has a name. It links to the related disclosure record.

Each row records a troubled debt restructuring (a restructured loan). It includes the unique identifier for the restructuring and any related names. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these restructurings.
Each row is a record of a foreign currency translation, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the currency. It links to financial disclosures for more details.
Each row represents a forward contract indexed to an issuer's equity. It records the contract's name. It links to disclosures that provide more details about the contract.
Each row records a fresh start adjustment, identified by an ID. It includes the name of the adjustment. It links to related disclosures for more details.

Each row records a gain or loss on investments. It includes an identifier and the name of the investment. It links to the broader disclosure record that contains it, allowing details of specific investment gains/losses to be found within overall financial disclosures.
Each row represents a goodwill entry, identified by a unique ID. It records the name associated with the goodwill. It links to related disclosures for more details.
Each row represents a guarantee, identified by a unique ID. It records the name associated with the guarantee. It links to related disclosures for more details.
Each row represents a guarantor obligation, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the guarantor. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these obligations.
Each row represents a security held to maturity, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the security. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these securities.

Each row represents a holding of an asset, identified by a unique ID. It records who holds the asset, what it is, and a description and count of how much is held. It links to the security being held, allowing details of each listed security's holdings to be found.
Each row represents an impaired financing receivable (an asset that may not be collectible). It records the receivable's name. It links to disclosures, providing details of such assets.
Each row represents an income tax contingency, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the contingency. It links to the broader disclosure record that contains it.
Each row represents an indefinite-lived intangible asset, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the asset. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these assets.
Each row defines an industry sector classification scheme, noting its unique identifier, name, and description. It links to the classifier that uses this scheme to categorize industries.
Each row defines an industry sector with a unique identifier, description, numeric code and formal name. It links to the classification scheme that defines it.
Each row represents an intangible asset or goodwill, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the asset or goodwill. It links to the disclosure that contains more details about it.
Each row records a source of income, specifically interest and other income. It includes the name of the income source. It links to the broader disclosure record that contains it.
Each row records an interest cost incurred, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the cost. It links to the disclosure record that contains more details about this cost.
Each row represents the current state of an inventory item, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the item. It links to financial disclosures for more details.
Each row represents a non-current asset in the company's inventory. It records the asset's name. It links to related disclosures, providing more context about the asset.
Each row represents an item of investment income. It records the name of the income source. It links to a broader disclosure record, providing more context about the financial details.

Each row represents an investment or other non-current asset. It records the asset's name. It links to the disclosure that contains this information, allowing details of specific assets to be found within a broader financial disclosure.
Each row represents a financial liability, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the liability. It links to the element of the financial statement it belongs to.
Each row represents a line of credit facility, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the facility. It links to related disclosures for more details.

Each row represents a listed security (a tradable financial asset). It records the last traded value, listing date, ticker symbol, and legal name of the security. It links to the security table and is referenced by tables tracking holdings and transactions involving these securities.
Each row represents a long-lived asset held for sale, identified by an ID. It records the name of the asset. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these assets.

Each row represents a long-lived asset that is planned for abandonment. It records the name of the asset. It links to disclosures, providing details on which assets are set to be abandoned and their names.
Each row represents a long-term debt identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the debt. It links to related disclosures, providing context about financial statements.
Each row represents a maturity period for long-term debt. It records the name of the maturity period. It links to the disclosure that contains it, providing context about financial disclosures.
Each row represents a long-term purchase commitment, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the commitment. It links to related disclosures for more details.
Each row represents a financial loss, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the loss. It links to the element of the financial statement where the loss is recorded.
Each row represents a marketable security (an investment that can be easily sold). It records the security's name. It links to disclosures, providing details of each security.
Each row represents a monetary amount, recording its unique identifier, the currency it is in, and the actual amount. It links to the currency table to specify which currency is used.
Each row represents a cost related to employee benefits that hasn't been recognized yet. It includes the cost's name. It links to the disclosure that contains more details about these costs.
Each row represents a new accounting pronouncement adopted early. It records the pronouncement's name. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these pronouncements.
Each row represents a non-controlling interest, identified by an ID. It records the name of the entity holding this interest. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these interests.
Each row represents an operating loss carryforward, recording whether it has a name. It links to the disclosure record that contains more details about the loss.

Each row represents an other asset, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the asset. It links to the disclosure table, allowing details about the assets to be associated with financial disclosures.

Each row represents an item in the category of other assets or other liabilities. It records a name for each item. This table links to disclosures, providing details on specific other assets or liabilities.
Each row discloses information about other assets. It records whether an asset has a specific name. It links to the broader disclosure record.

Each row represents a non-current asset (an asset that is not expected to be converted into cash within one year). It records the name of the asset. It links to the disclosure table, allowing details about these assets to be linked to broader financial disclosures.
Each row discloses an additional liability (a financial obligation not covered elsewhere). It records the name of the liability. It links to the broader disclosure record that contains it.
Each row records an item of other non-operating income or expense, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the item. It links to the full disclosure text that describes it.
Each row represents an additional ownership interest. It records the name of the interest holder. It links to the main disclosure record, showing which disclosures include these interests.

Each row records a credit loss recognized due to other-than-temporary impairment. It includes an identifier and the name of the loss. It links to disclosures, providing details on how these losses are reported in earnings.

Each row represents a person, recording their ID, name (first, middle and last names), date of birth, gender, citizenship, and place of birth. It links to the country where the person was born and connects to tables for contracts and financial accounts showing who they are associated with.
Each row is a phone number, identified by a unique ID. It records whether the number has a value. It links to the virtual address table, allowing phone numbers and addresses to be associated.
Each row is a postal address, recording the country, lines of the address, city, postal code, and state. It links to the country to provide full address details.
Each row represents a preferred stock issue, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the stock. It links to disclosures that provide more details about the stock.
Each row represents a warranty liability for a product. It records the name of the warranty. It links to disclosures, providing context about financial liabilities related to warranties.
Each row is a property management fee, identified by an ID. It records the name of the fee. It links to disclosures, providing details about the fee in financial documents.
Each row represents a piece of property, plant, and equipment (PP&E). It records the PP&E's name. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these assets.

Each row discloses information about property, plant, and equipment in the income statement. It records a unique identifier and the name of the disclosure. It links to the broader disclosure table for more details.
Each row defines the useful life of a type of property, plant, and equipment. It records the name of the asset class. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these asset lives.
Each row represents a property that is either subject to or available for an operating lease. It records the property's name. This table links to disclosures, providing details of leased properties.
Each row represents a real estate property, identified by its unique ID. It contains the property's name. It links to disclosure information related to the property.

Each row records a realized gain or loss, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the item or asset involved. It links to the disclosure table, showing which disclosures include these gains and losses.
Each row records a realized gain or loss on investments. It includes an identifier and the name of the investment. It links to disclosures, providing details of financial statements.
Each row reconciles the operating profit or loss from segments to the consolidated figure. It records a name related to this reconciliation. It links to disclosures that provide more details.
Each row records an unconditional purchase obligation, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the obligation. It links to disclosures that provide more details.

Each row represents a redeemable non-controlling interest, identified by an ID. It records the name of this financial instrument. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these interests.

Each row records a transaction with a related party. It includes the unique identifier for the transaction and the name of the related party involved. It links to the disclosure record that contains more details about the transaction.
Each row records a rent expense, identified by an ID. It includes the name of the expense. It links to financial disclosures for more details.
Each row represents a restricted cash or cash equivalent account. It records the name of the account. It links to the disclosure that contains this information, providing context for its use.
Each row records a cost related to restructuring, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the cost. It links to the broader disclosure record that contains it.
Each row represents a revenue entry, identified by a unique ID. It records the name of the revenue item. It links to the financial statement element, showing where this revenue is recorded.
Each row represents a sale and leaseback transaction, recording whether it has a name. It links to related disclosures for more details.

Each row represents a securities transaction (buying or selling stocks). It records who facilitated the transaction, the price, the type of security, the settlement date and the count. It links to the specific stock being traded, allowing details of each transaction to be matched to its corresponding security.

Each row represents a security (like a stock or bond). It records the market where it is traded and who provides the data. It links to the trading market, allowing you to see where each security trades.
Each row represents an activity related to share-based compensation. It records the name of the activity. It links to disclosures, providing context for financial statements.

Each row represents a share-based compensation arrangement, detailing the grant date and intrinsic value of options or grants. It records the name associated with each arrangement. It links to disclosures for more details.

Each row represents the weighted average grant date fair value of share-based payment awards in a compensation arrangement. It records the unique identifier and the name of the arrangement. It links to disclosures, providing context for financial statements.

Each row represents a share-based compensation arrangement, detailing options that have vested or are expected to vest and become exercisable. It includes the name of the arrangement. It links to disclosures for more details.

Each row represents a share-based compensation arrangement, detailing options that have vested or are expected to vest. It includes the name of the arrangement. It links to the disclosure record for more details.

Each row represents a share-based compensation arrangement, specifically restricted stock units that have vested or are expected to vest. It records the unique identifier and the name of the arrangement. It links to the disclosure record for more details.

Each row records activity related to restricted stock units awarded as part of a share-based compensation plan. It includes the unique identifier for each award. This table links to disclosures that provide more details about these awards.
Each row represents a short-term debt, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the debt. It links to related disclosures for more details.
Each row represents a stockholders equity item, identified by an ID. It contains the name of the equity holder. It links to the disclosure record that includes this equity information.

Each row represents a subsequent event (an important event after the balance sheet date but before the financial statements are issued). It records the name of the event. It links to disclosures, providing more detail on these events.
Each row represents a tax credit carryforward, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the credit. It links to the disclosure table for more details.

Each row represents a trading security or other asset held for trading purposes. It records the name of the security or asset. It links to the disclosure that contains it, providing context on financial disclosures.
Each row represents a treasury stock entry, recording the name of the stock. It links to disclosure information, allowing details about the stock's status and value to be found.
Each row records an unrealized gain or loss on investments. It includes a unique identifier and the name of the investment. It links to disclosures, providing details of financial statements.
Each row records an unrealized loss on investments, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the investment. It links to disclosures that provide more details about these losses.
Each row represents an unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation, identified by a unique ID. It includes the name of the obligation. It links to disclosures that provide more details.
Each row discloses an unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation. It records the name of the obligation. It links to the broader disclosure record that contains it.
Each row represents a valuation allowance, identified by an ID. It includes the name of the allowance. It links to related disclosures for more details.
Each row discloses information about valuation and qualifying accounts. It records the name of the account. This table links to the broader disclosure record, providing details within it.
Each row is a virtual address, identified by a unique ID. It connects to other tables like addresses, emails and phone numbers, allowing these to reference the same virtual address.
Each row represents a weighted average number of shares, identified by a unique ID. It records the name associated with this value. It links to financial disclosures for more context.
